name: Setsugekka
message: 「Phew... no one’s here, right？」
I walked out of the school gates and made it to the front of the convenience store.
Today, I told the school I was taking the day off because I wasn't feeling well.
But that 'not feeling well' part is a lie.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, look, it’s still awkward to face Muragaki-sensei...」
If it were just being caught masturbating, that still would’ve been fine.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Actually, no, that wouldn’t have been fine.」
The awkward part is that I was busy getting off using Muragaki-sensei as my material, only to have the man himself witness the whole thing.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Foaaah— seriously, I could just die even thinking about it—！」
I hopped up and down on the spot.
In my delusions, Muragaki-sensei is a total technician.
Even though we barely just met, he knows my weakest spots perfectly and goes on to torment them without mercy.
『Come on, Setsugekka, this is where it feels good for you, isn't it...？』

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...stuff like that！ Nyuhehehe！」
Thanks to Muragaki-sensei’s transcendent technique in my head, I reached my climax in no time.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-the problem is that the man himself saw that.」
That’s, like, fifty times more embarrassing than just being caught masturbating.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, seriously, I can't show my face to him anymore！ It's absolutely impossible！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haah... maybe I should just let it actually happen...」
No, get a grip, me. Is that even the kind of relationship I want with Muragaki-sensei？

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...ufufu」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No, no, no, no, that’s no good！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't take it, just forget it！ Let’s just cleanly and completely forget about it today！」
That’s exactly why I skipped school, after all.
Because there’s an outdoor training ground right nearby, nobody gets suspicious even if there are students loitering around skipping class.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Fufun, Sensei won't find me here. Nice idea, if I do say so myself.」
Well, if I did get caught by him, I’d just run away, so there’s no real harm done.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What’s actually bad is if Kei-chan finds out...」
If she ever found out I skipped school, Kei-chan would be absolutely furious.
Then she’d grill me until I confessed every single reason why I stayed home. There’s no escaping once Kei-chan gets serious.
The result: Kei-chan finds out about the Muragaki-sensei masturbation delusion incident.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uwaaah—! That would be the worst thing ever—!」
Just imagining it, the sheer terror, shame, and unbearable feeling made me roll around on the asphalt.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ouch！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...What are you making such a ruckus for?」
Hearing a familiar voice, I looked up.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「S-Sono-chan-senpai！？」
Sono-chan-senpai was sitting in the shadow of the convenience store.

name: Sonomi
message: 「I was wondering who was making all that noise, and it turns out it’s you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Good morning, Master!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Don’t call me Master. I never intended to be your master.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, don’t say things like that~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really look up to you, Sono-chan-senpai, you know.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Cut that out... It’s throwing me off.」
After shaking off Muragaki-sensei, I stuck with senpai and talked for a little bit.
As a result, I learned one thing.
Sono-chan-senpai might look and act a bit scary, but she’s surprisingly shy and easily embarrassed.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Did you see Nakamura Sakura-san’s match yesterday？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, I saw it. It was pretty good.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We got to hear Sakura-san’s signature line for the first time in a while！」

name: Setsugekka & Sonomi
message: 「I’m going to scatter that flowerbed of yours all over the place right now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh~~~ so cool！！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Gives you chills, doesn't it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Exactly, she’s so admirable!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, I kind of look like an airhead, don't I?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「It’s not just your looks, it’s your personality too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wha—you’re saying my personality is an airhead too！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gnu-nu, I’m frustrated, but it makes me happy to be insulted by Sono-chan-senpai, so it balances out!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「That’s exactly what I mean.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But wouldn’t you also be happy, Sono-chan-senpai, if you were belittled by Nakamura Sakura-san？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well, it comes across that she’s taking you seriously, doesn't it.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「In that sense, I guess I’m happy, yeah.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right? It just makes you feel like, 'please, bully me more,' doesn't it.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「No, it really doesn’t.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah, I want to be like Sakura-san too...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You aren't really that type of person, are you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That！ That right there！」
I point my finger squarely at Sono-chan-senpai.

name: Sonomi
message: 「Huh? What’s that?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don't you think people should be the ones to decide their own character？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yet, why is it that everyone around me decides what my character is！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, people keep telling me I’m like a Chihuahua.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Ah... I kind of get that.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I think that means I’m being looked down on！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, 'A Chihuahua?！ A small dog?！ Why not a wolf?！' you know?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well, you’re definitely not cut out to be a wolf.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Argh！ That’s what pisses me off, I can’t accept it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「For example, Sono-chan-senpai looks scary, so I don't think you get looked down on when you first meet people.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Well... I mean, if anyone tried to cop an attitude with me, I’d beat the crap out of them.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Exactly！ I knew it！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s the kind of thing I want to learn from you, Sono-chan-senpai.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to get to a point where people don't look down on me~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, Master, won't you teach me something？」
Sono-chan-senpai gives me a dead-eyed stare.

name: Sonomi
message: 「...Tsukasa, why the hell are you pestering me?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What’s your game?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ My game, you say...」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’ll tell you this much: I ain’t got no intention of hanging out with anyone.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Why not？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Everyone at this school, I can’t stand any of ‘em.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Whether they’re from samurai families or rich little rich kids, they’re all just soft brats raised in luxury on their parents’ money.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Watching them grab their swords and make such a racket over winning or losing matches, it’s honestly laughable. Are they stupid or what?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Samurai back in the day, once they drew their blades, they fought until someone was dead.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Only the winner survives; the loser dies.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’ve been putting my life on the line since the day I was born. My resolve is on a different level than those people.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In other words, you have no interest in hanging out with coddled little rich boys and girls.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You’re quick on the uptake. In short, that means you too...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I totally, completely agree, Master！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Man, I’ve been thinking the exact same thing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I mean, everyone’s making such a fuss about that Suzakuin girl enrolling this year, aren't they?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Just because she’s got a bit of pedigree, she gets special treatment and everyone fawns over her. It makes me want to scream, ‘Are you kidding me?’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What year do they think it is? The Edo period ended a long time ago.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「O-oh.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s why I’ve made up my mind.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m going to be the one to defeat Suzakuin Momiji with my own hands.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I won’t let anyone else do it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m going to be the one to drag her through the mud; I swear it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Isn't that what you’re trying to say, Sono-chan-senpai？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Pfft, hehe, ahahahaha…！」
As I asked, Sono-chan-senpai suddenly burst into laughter.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「H-huh？ Did I say something weird？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「What are you, you’ve actually got some real guts, don’t ya?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You’ve got a face like you live in a flower garden, but you sure can talk tough.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I’m the one who gets scattered by Nakamura Sakura-san♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Which isn't a good thing at all！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You’re so lucky, Sono-chan-senpai, being such a cool beauty！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Please, trade faces with me.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Spare me. I don’t think I could survive living with your face.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How mean！ Apologize to me, the one who’s had to live with this face my whole life~！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「...What’s your name？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hm？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Your name. I haven’t asked you yet, have I?」
Come to think of it, she hadn't.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uh, it’s Kazamine Setsugekka.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Setsugekka? That’s a long name. How about I call you Setchin?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「'Setchin'? Uh, that’s actually a word for a toilet, you know…」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’m hungry, Setchin. Let’s go get something to eat.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You aren't even listening！」
Without paying any mind to my protest, Sono-chan-senpai started walking away.
Her expression was just a tiny bit softer than it had been when we first met.
